data.why: The repo ships no example data, so small RELION .star, coordinate .csv, and EMAN2 .box files matching each parser's expected columns were written to the server-local data/ folder (where the dashboard's text-input file path can find them), including a low-particle-count micrograph (micrograph_005, a likely failed pick), a missing coordinate value in the CSV, and an oversized/non-square box as outliers for the dashboard's statistics and quality views to surface.

goals: Load a RELION .star particle file and review total particle and micrograph counts, plus per-micrograph distribution
Spot micrographs with unusually few or many picked particles that may indicate a failed or over-aggressive picking run
Inspect the spatial distribution of picked coordinates on a micrograph via the scatter plot and density heatmap to catch edge artifacts or clustering
Compare defocus distributions (DefocusU/DefocusV) across particles to flag out-of-range CTF estimates
Load the same picking run exported as .csv or .box and confirm consistent particle counts across formats
Identify malformed rows (missing coordinates) that fail to parse and understand how the dashboard reports them

review.summary: The tree captures what the dashboard is for: checking the quality of particle picking per micrograph from .star, .csv or .box files. Its phases, tasks and features are well cut, and every screen I opened shows what its node claims. It needs fixes before filing: two notes put the blame in the wrong place (the CSV defocus panel and the empty .box charts), it misses the silently kept malformed CSV row its own screen shows, and it needs a few label and placement corrections.
